account.deleteGuideBody:
Deleting your account permanently removes the following, and it cannot be recovered.

• All registered pet profiles
• Medical records, appointments, vaccination records
• Health diaries, health metrics, daily care
• Community posts, comments, likes
• Care-sharing relationships
• Account info such as your nickname

※ App Store / Google Play subscriptions must be canceled separately. Deleting your account does not stop billing.

diary.body: Record your days together on a monthly calendar and see visits and schedules on one screen.

daily.title: Daily
daily.body: Manage daily care checks like food, treats, supplements, and walks, plus weekly and monthly routine checks and metrics such as weight and water intake — all in one place.

health.body: Manage appointments, records, and vaccination schedules in one place. Get a reminder for the next vaccine due date.

more.title: More
more.body: Pet management, sharing, theme, subscription, and the owner community — all your settings and quick access in one place.
